observed_behavior: Missing or legacy executable annotations prevented reporting any campaign vector.
expected_behavior: Measure reviewed requirement decomposition while preserving malformed legacy relationship markers as completion blockers.
causal_mechanism: All marker findings were treated as inventory failures, although reviewed R/A decomposition and strict graph ownership already govern the inventory.

anti_pattern.structural_description: An acceptance gate was reused as a prerequisite for reporting incomplete progress.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The command could not report the unresolved implementation and test work it was intended to measure.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Canonical inventory must be sound; incomplete executable coverage must remain visible without masquerading as completion.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Retain fatal scope and graph ownership errors; report marker diagnostics with completionBlocked and grant no coverage from malformed markers.

applicability_conditions: Canonical inventory is valid but executable annotations require migration
known_non_matches: A declared acceptance with no valid obligation edge still fails graph ownership validation.
confirmation_evidence: Gwen discovery distinguished executable findings from canonical Markdown errors; fixtures verify both gates and zero-with-diagnostics behavior.
regression_proofs: tests/traceability-completeness.test.ts: legacy marker diagnostics retain progress while broken declared ownership rejects it
tests/traceability-completeness.test.ts: a zero vector with executable diagnostics still blocks completion
